[ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p371/r1] ISLAHI-TADABBUR · author | holds | The sūrah recalls a town warned by two messengers, then a third helper; its people rejected them, blamed the warning signs, threatened them, and were destroyed.
